decisions.reason: Selecting the Seattle location page as the future-location template does not change the master site's location-selection or routing behavior.
The booking-ready Seattle page becomes the future-location template, so the existing same-message Event should also retain the reusable booking-activation behavior.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SMASH ROOM brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Seattle should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Seattle Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

The page should be designed so that once Seattle opens, we only need to turn on booking and update photos without redesigning the page.

The Seattle page should become the template for future locations.

value_updates.seattle_booking_status: Booking remains off while Seattle is a Coming Soon location
value_updates.seattle_booking_activation: Turn on booking when Seattle opens without redesigning the page
value_updates.future_location_booking_activation: Future location pages based on the Seattle template must allow booking to be turned on without redesigning the page

decisions.reason: The candidate already requires consistent Smash Room branding across present and future locations; naming Seattle as the page template does not change that brand requirement.
The source change selects Seattle's page as a reusable frontend template and does not establish a new operational-isolation rule beyond the candidate's existing per-location separation state.
The template designation does not alter the candidate's established visual style, layout characteristics, or location-page scope.
Choosing Seattle as the future location-page template does not change the master site's assigned domain.
